children: "Warren built Berkshire to endure, and we are grateful beyond measure for what he put in place. We are fortunate he will continue to serve as a Director, and to have his counsel."

"This is a great team for Berkshire's shareholders. [Buffett's son] Howard has served Berkshire's owners on this Board for more than three decades. He is direct, thoughtful, and deeply cares about this company. That is exactly what you want in a chairman. And Sue [Decker] brings her keen insights and managerial expertise to her role as lead independent director."

A "masterclass in corporate succession," the economist said in a post on X. "In a characteristically humble and well-written letter to Berkshire shareholders, Warren Buffett reflects on his tenure, passes the Chair role to Howard Buffett, and reaffirms his confidence in Greg Abel."
